```python
import polars as pl

# Create a DataFrame with duplicate rows
df = pl.DataFrame({
    "id": [1, 2, 3, 2, 1, 4],
    "name": ["Alice", "Bob", "Charlie", "Bob", "Alice", "David"],
    "value": [10, 20, 30, 20, 10, 40]
})

# Remove duplicates, keeping the first occurrence of each distinct row
result = df.unique(keep='first')

print(result)
```
